reply: Thank you for explaining that your vehicle was declared a total loss, but the insurer has not paid off your loan and late payments are now being reported. We understand the effect on your credit. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the claim number and timeline, ask the lender in writing about the claim status, and dispute the late entries with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sold a vehicle that still had a loan, and that the transfer was never completed by the buyer, leaving the account on your record for years. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the signed bill of sale and the release of liability, and ask in writing for the account's current status. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you cancelled a $10,000.00 extended warranty in time, but the dealer closed before processing it and your loan balance has not been adjusted. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep your written cancellation request, and ask the lender and warranty provider in writing for the refund to be applied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that late payments are reported after your voluntary surrender, along with conflicting statuses, balances and dates across accounts. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list each inconsistent item and dispute it with the credit reporting companies, including your surrender records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your vehicle was repossessed after payment handling errors, and that you received a surplus refund of about $2,500.00 after the sale. We understand your concern about the reporting. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the refund check record and your payment history, and dispute any inaccurate details with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid the exact $510.00 payoff amount you were quoted, but the loan still shows a balance. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the payoff quote and your bank's confirmation, and send a written request for the payment to be traced and the loan marked as paid. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you question the lender's right to collect on your loan and how your down payment of $10,000.00 or more was handled. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for a copy of your signed contract, any assignment showing who holds it, and a payment history. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $3,100.00 refund for cancelled service contracts was issued to your lender, but the lender says it never received it. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the administrator's confirmation of the check number and date, and ask both parties in writing to trace it. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your payments are processed inconsistently each month, leading to late and returned payment fees even though your bank confirms the funds were there. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep your bank's confirmations, and ask in writing for a review of the fees and the cause of the problem. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after your vehicle was repossessed you received no written notices about your right to redeem it or about any sale. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send a written request for confirmation of whether the vehicle was sold and copies of all notices sent. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a phone payment did not record properly, that you made a payment the next day, and that you were charged a fee for the failed payment. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the confirmation of your phone attempt and the later payment, and ask in writing for a review of the fee. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $1,200.00 manufacturer rebate was listed as your down payment, contrary to what you were told at the sale. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the contract and any advertising or messages from the dealer, and ask in writing for an explanation of how the rebate was applied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an auto account has been on your credit report for nearly eight years and that you believe it should now be removed. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Most negative information stays on a report for about seven years, so please ask the credit reporting companies to check the reporting period. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you bought out your lease for $2,100.00, but were later billed $5,600.00 for excess mileage and sent to collections. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lease team. Please keep your bank record of the purchase and the order details, and dispute the collection with the credit reporting companies as well. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are being contacted for a payment the company's own website and text messages showed was not yet due. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep the screenshots showing your account as current, and ask in writing for your correct due date and payment history. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your request to change your due date to match your payday was refused, and that your car was repossessed without notice beforehand. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for copies of any notices sent and a breakdown of the balance after the sale. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you want any amount above your $710.00 payment applied only to principal, but it is being applied to future payments. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please send written instructions that extra payments go to principal, and ask for written confirmation of how they will be applied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your final lease statement lists property tax amounts that your local tax office says are incorrect. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lease team. Please keep the information from the tax office, and ask in writing for copies of the tax bills used to calculate the charges. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are told your payments were not received even though your bank statements show them, and that your due date request has not been answered. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please send your bank statements with a written request for each payment to be traced, and repeat your due date request in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your auto loan balance seems higher than it should be and that you have not received a complete accounting. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send a written request for your contract and a full payment history showing interest, fees and principal. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your repossession is reported with a remaining balance you question, and that you have not received a breakdown. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send a written request for the sale price, fees and balance calculation, and dispute any inaccurate details with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked for a voluntary repossession on a recorded call, but the vehicle was not picked up for many months. We understand your concern about the costs since then. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for the date of your request, any notices sent and a breakdown of the balance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you keep receiving unwanted mail offers and that your call to stop them was ended before you could confirm. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the marketing team. Please send a written request to be removed from the mailing list, and you can also opt out of prescreened offers. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your rate was lowered under servicemember protections, but your automatic payments were turned off without notice, causing missed payments. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for autopay to be restored and the late reports reviewed, and dispute them with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your vehicle was in the shop for over a year and that you dispute the repossession and the charged-off account. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the repair records and any buyback offer, and ask in writing for the documents you requested. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you returned your leased vehicle at the end of the term and found an auto loan issue that the bank has not helped resolve. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send a written summary of the issue with your lease return documents, and ask for a specific list of anything else needed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your middle name is wrong on your loan and title documents, and that this is delaying your refinance. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the title services team. Please send a written request for correction with a copy of your ID, and ask what is needed from the dealer. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the credit union took your vehicle title at purchase and later said it had lost it, leaving your registration unfinished. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the title services team. Please keep your purchase package, and ask in writing for the steps and timeline for obtaining a duplicate title. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that since your loan moved to a new company you have had late fees, changed payment terms and difficulty reaching a manager. We understand your frustration on a fixed income. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for your current contract and payment history, and repeat your refinance request in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you urgently need a payoff quote to sell your car, but the website and phone line have been down. We understand the urgency. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the auto lending team. Please send a written request for a payoff quote to the address on your statement, and keep a copy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
